SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_s1 AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.size_class" AS "size_class",
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
    _stage_inner."orders.n" AS "n"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.size_class",
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
      COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _base AS (
  SELECT
    s1.size_class AS "s1.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date) AS "s1.order_date",
    SUM(s1.n) AS "s1.orders"
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  GROUP BY
    s1.size_class,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date)
), _cm_s1__n_sum_partition_by_order_date AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date) AS "s1.order_date",
    SUM(s1.n) AS "s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date"
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."s1.size_class",
    _base."s1.order_date",
    _base."s1.orders",
    _base."s1.orders" / _cm_s1__n_sum_partition_by_order_date."s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date" AS "s1.share",
    _cm_s1__n_sum_partition_by_order_date."s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date" AS "s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_s1__n_sum_partition_by_order_date
    ON _base."s1.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_s1__n_sum_partition_by_order_date."s1.order_date"
), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    s1.size_class AS "s1.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date) AS "s1.order_date",
    SUM(s1.n) AS "s1.orders"
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  GROUP BY
    s1.size_class,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s1.order_date)
), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    base."s1.size_class",
    base."s1.order_date",
    base."s1.orders",
    base."s1.share",
    base."s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date",
    shifted__time_shift_inner."s1.orders" AS "s1._time_shift_inner"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner
    ON base."s1.size_class" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."s1.size_class"
    AND base."s1.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."s1.order_date"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "s1.size_class",
    "s1.order_date",
    "s1.orders",
    "s1.share",
    "s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date",
    "s1._time_shift_inner",
    "s1.orders" - "s1._time_shift_inner" AS "s1.chg"
  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner
)
SELECT
  "s1.size_class",
  "s1.order_date",
  "s1.orders",
  "s1.share",
  "s1.chg"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "s1.size_class",
    "s1.order_date",
    "s1.orders",
    "s1.share",
    "s1.n_sum_partition_by_order_date",
    "s1._time_shift_inner",
    "s1.chg"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "s1.order_date" ASC,
  "s1.size_class" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: I grouped orders by month and size class: 'big' means amount over 100, 'small' means 100 or less. The class is defined inside the query only, so the stored data model is unchanged.
